5982.title: Sole editor hard breaks do not survive Markdown persistence
5982.rootCauseOneLine: The default hard-break serializer emits nothing without a later non-break sibling, dropping a sole intentional break on save/reload in all three tested containers.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — related work, case deferred
prReviews.topFinding: A first/last-child serializer branch emits a standalone break tag; no corresponding block-parser exception is present. PR code was not executed.

5982.proposedFix: Define a narrow break-only persistence representation and matching parser rule; retain raw HTML source behavior and the three-context round-trip regression.
5982.caveats: Main loses the break but does not emit HTML source. PR-only runtime behavior is unverified. Open PR 5968 links the issue, so the duplicate-PR stop applies. Reproduction test and observations are inline per report repository policy.
